product_name_review.sampling: 30 pre-policy crossing keys in each size band: 2, 3-5, 6-10, and 11+ rows; exact/collision quarantine excluded
product_name_review.interpretation: The name key is a conservative blocking signal, not proof of one SKU. False merges reduce effective sample size but cannot leak a name block across active partitions. The provisional calls are not human-validated evidence until team sign-off.

pre_policy_crossing_triage.normalization: case-fold text and collapse whitespace; blank keys excluded
pre_policy_crossing_triage.scope: non-quarantine normalized-name groups with more than one SHA-256 and more than one partition
pre_policy_crossing_triage.interpretation: triage signal only; a shared normalized name is not proof of one product
pre_policy_crossing_triage.limitation: The source split was superseded by the accepted family split. Its digest is retained so this historical count cannot be mistaken for the current zero-crossing result.

policy: First quarantine exact and all pending-or-confirmed cross-role visual components, plus conflicting exact hashes. Then block each remaining normalized name, exact hash, and accepted visual component for train/validation/holdout allocation.
